subject: Weekend runbook: Saturday morning console + API walkthrough
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Gupta <samira.gupta@lumenbank.us>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekend runbook: Saturday morning console + API walkthrough

Hi Samira —

Quick note following our call last week: since LumenBank's ops team prefers a non-business-hours window, would Saturday morning PST work for a focused runbook session (console + API enablement)? Goal: step through the production console runbook, demo the token/workflow for automated ingestion, and leave time for hands-on API key exchange and a short smoke test.

Availability from our side (PST):
- Sat Nov 14: 08:00–11:00 or 12:00–15:00
- Sun Nov 15: 09:00–12:00 (backup)

I've attached the draft runbook and a suggested agenda. If one of the time blocks looks good, I'll send a calendar invite and an ops-ready calendar ICS for your team to import. We can also include Alex from our enablement partner for the API deep-dive if you want additional bandwidth.

Attachments: runbook_v1.pdf (draft runbook), session_agenda.md

High-level agenda:
- 08:00–08:30: Console walkthrough (access + roles)
- 08:30–09:15: API token exchange and live key test (sample payloads)
- 09:15–10:00: Runbook smoke tests and failover scenarios
- 10:00–11:00: Q&A + follow-ups (action items + access tickets)

Please reply with which slot you prefer and any folks to add.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan —

Thanks — Saturday would be ideal. Our ops lead prefers earlier rather than later; Sat Nov 14 at 10:00 AM EST would be best for their team (that should be 07:00 PST). Would that be too early for your folks? If needed we can shift to 11:00 AM EST (08:00 PST).

Two quick asks from our side:
1) We need a short pre-check list for accounts that will join (browser versions, VPN notes, SSO expectations).
2) For the API piece, can you confirm whether temporary tokens will be used or we should provision a long-lived test key? We prefer temporary tokens but need guidance on rotation.

If Saturday morning works, I can circulate a short invite to our ops and security SMEs.

Best,
Samira
Samira Gupta
Director, Platform Operations | LumenBank

Hi Samira —

07:00 PST (10:00 EST) is doable for the core enablement team; Jordan and I can cover the console and API flow. Ben will handle the sandbox provisioning and will be on call for token exchange.

Answers to your asks:
- Pre-check list: attached is a short "join checklist" (I added a page to runbook_v1.pdf and summarized in session_agenda.md). It includes SSO vs email access, recommended browsers (Chrome latest / Firefox ESR), and a VPN note — if your team uses an outbound proxy we ask them to allow connections to the Redwood proxy endpoints listed on the runbook.
- Tokens: we'll use short-lived test tokens for the live exchange and show how to exchange for a scoped, time-limited token. We'll also demo how to persist the token in a safe way and demonstrate rotation with our CLI snippet.

I added a quick link to a small pre-flight checklist in Drive. If you confirm the attendee list, I'll send a calendar invite (ICS) and include the lab ICS for import so your schedulers can block the time.

Attachment: lumen_console_quickstart.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xRunbookFolder

Thanks,
Camila
